text: 1. Not of Chinese nationality but holding a valid foreign passport.And there is a record of having actually resided abroad for more than two years within the last four years (up to April 30 of the admission year).2. Be in good physical and mental health and meet the physical examination standards for applying for a study visa or residence permit to China.3. Age and educational requirements: (1) Master's degree candidates: Under 35 years old, with a degree equivalent to a bachelor's degree from a Chinese university.(2) Doctoral candidates: Under 40 years old, with a degree equivalent to a master's degree from a Chinese university.4. Diligent and eager to learn, with good academic performance, upright conduct, abiding by laws and regulations, no record of violating school rules and regulations, no record of public security penalties, and no criminal record.5. Language proficiency requirements:Chinese-taught programs: Proof of HSK Level 5 (with a score of no less than 180) or other equivalent Chinese proficiency test results is required.For English-taught programs, applicants whose native language is not English must have proof of IELTS Academic (with no less than 6.5 in each section), TOEFL (with no less than 90 in IBT and no less than 20 in each section), or other equivalent English test scores. Applicants whose native language is English or whose highest academic degree was taught entirely in English may be exempted from the English test score certificate, but they must submit a certificate of English teaching issued by their graduating school.
